title_template: {work_unit_id} — Governed frontier lifecycle and in-PR advancement
goal: Eliminate stale-frontier replay by making frontier consumption and advancement a deterministic, fail-closed part of each governed frontier-derived Work Unit transaction.
scope: define a machine-readable frontier lifecycle contract with exact predecessor frontier identity and selected Work Unit binding
require each non-terminal frontier-derived Work Unit to advance the dynamic frontier in the same bounded Work Unit PR before merge, or set it to NONE when no next frontier exists
add a read-only fail-closed validator/evaluator and hosted regression gate that rejects replay of a consumed or completed frontier
preserve the existing materialization planner, materialization policy, reusable materialization grant, selector and Work Unit schema byte-for-byte
as the WU-104 completion transition, advance the frontier to the exact ADWF Consumer Project Pack provenance reconciliation derived from fresh PNCC and ADWF provider truth
forbidden_scope: change the reusable materialization authority or its immutable planner/policy/selector/schema anchors
manually create or mutate a canonical Work Unit Issue outside the already-authorized reusable materializer
mutate .adwf-consumer binding or readiness in this frontier-lifecycle Work Unit
mutate provider-state or Writer Lease semantics outside existing separately authorized lifecycle contracts
perform runtime or product/runtime source mutation
mutate the ADWF repository, release/tag/promotion state, rulesets, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: the historical WU-103 frontier cannot be replayed after WU-103 completion
a frontier-derived Work Unit cannot reach merge eligibility while leaving its consumed frontier unchanged unless the frontier is explicitly terminal NONE
materialization planner, materialization policy, reusable materialization grant, selector and Work Unit schema blobs remain unchanged
WU-104 advances the canonical frontier in its own bounded PR to the exact next ADWF Consumer Project Pack provenance reconciliation frontier
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, provider-state, ADWF binding or 1080/1081 mutation
